description.it: I migliori giocatori fino a 21 anni in tutto il database.
description.en: The best players aged 21 or under in the whole database.

widgets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM players WHERE age <= 21 AND ability_current >= 120
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM players WHERE age <= 19 AND ability_current >= 100
SELECT name || ' (' || ability_current || ')' AS value FROM players WHERE age <= 21 ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 1

title.it: Under 21 con abilità attuale ≥ 100, per età
title.en: Under-21s with current ability ≥ 100, by age

widgets.sql: SELECT age, count(*) AS players FROM players WHERE age <= 21 AND ability_current >= 100 GROUP BY age ORDER BY age

widgets.label: name
widgets.sql: SELECT name, age, ability_current FROM players WHERE age <= 21 ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT name, age, club_name, natural_positions AS positions, ability_current, ability_potential, transfer_value FROM players WHERE age <= 21 ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 100
